name: 23053 - Crockett Gym AISD
description: Crockett high school gym with AISD
prompt_template:
This is a New Gym project for Crockett High School by Austin ISD. Pfluger is partnering with Timberlab to design the Structural Beams and Roof for the main gym using Timber. All the columns will be Steel columns. Tsen Engineering are the structural engineers on the project that will be helping with everything not related to Mass Timber. Swinerton are the contractors. The base of the building all across the perimeter will be CMU with masonry for upto 14 feet height and then for the portion above it will be Metal Stud wall with Metal panels cladding. The supporting spaces and lower roof won't have a timber roof - it will be the conventional metal roofing. Almost half of the High School site has been affected by the Flood Plain and hence, the designing of this gym restarted in Fall 2025 after having completed the 95% CD set in 2024. The floor plain issue was discovered in 2025. The project will now follow all 2024 applicable codes. 75% CD set will be issued on January 16, 2026 and the 95% CD set will be delivered on February 20, 2026.

Always cite your sources to the documents for factual data.
